key_findings_zh: 病毒血症与更多但仍然轻微的临床症状相关,而二次感染导致更高的病毒血症、中和抗体水平和保护性 T 细胞应答。 [10.1126/scitranslmed.aei5117]
研究结果显示,DENV-2感染在上皮细胞系和原代人类B淋巴细胞中均能持续诱导EBV裂解基因表达和病毒复制。IRE1或XBP1的耗竭会减弱DENV诱导的BZLF1表达,而XBP1s的过表达则会增加BZLF1的转录。 [10.1128/spectrum.01387-26]
研究发现,对DENV4具有基线免疫力的儿童中,疫苗被抑制的频率很高(61%),而对其他血清型具有免疫力的儿童则表现出二次交叉中和抗体反应。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag522]
与体重正常的儿童相比,肥胖儿童的结合抗体数量更高,但中和抗体无差异。瘦素与更高的结合抗体数量相关,而脂联素与更低的结合抗体数量相关,两者均未影响中和抗体水平。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag513]
我们报告了多种具有显著差异表达的基因以及多个可被重新利用的预测药物靶点,以减轻与DENV感染相关的症状和体征。 [10.20944/preprints202610.2605.v1]

key_findings_en: Viremia was associated with more, but still mild, clinical signs and symptoms, and secondary infection resulted in greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. [10.1126/scitranslmed.aei5117]

DENV-2 infection was shown to consistently induce EBV lytic gene expression and viral replication in both epithelial cell lines and primary human B lymphocytes. Depletion of IRE1 or XBP1 reduced DENV-induced BZLF1 expression, while ectopic XBP1s expression increased BZLF1 transcription. [10.1128/spectrum.01387-26]

The study found that children with baseline immunity to DENV4 had a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression, while those with immunity to other serotypes showed secondary cross-neutralizing Ab responses. [10.1093/infdis/jiag522]

Children with obesity had higher quantities of binding antibodies but no difference in neutralizing antibodies compared to those with normal weight. Leptin was associated with higher binding antibodies, while adiponectin was associated with lower binding antibodies, with no effect on neutralizing antibodies. [10.1093/infdis/jiag513]

We report various genes with significant differential expression and multiple predicted drug targets that could be repurposed to reduce the signs and symptoms associated with DENV infection. [10.20944/preprints202610.2605.v1]

papers.title: Dengue virus controlled human challenge reveals that preexisting immunity shapes viral replication and broadly protective responses
papers.abstract: Dengue is the canonical viral disease for which immune history is a determinant of protective versus pathogenic responses and immunogenicity. Yet, because of limitations in animal models and clinical presentation after peak viremia, how preinfection and early immune responses affect dengue outcome is not confirmed. We conducted a phase 1 clinical trial with 45 healthy adults to test whether secondary infection challenge with a heterotypic, full-length, attenuated virus increases viremia and immunogenicity compared with primary and tertiary infection. Viremia was associated with more, but still mild, clinical signs and symptoms, and secondary infection resulted in greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. However, those whose baseline antibodies most efficiently increased dengue virus replication in an in vitro assay experienced delayed inflammatory and adaptive immune activation, the highest viremia, strong acute immune responses, and waning of potent CD8 + T cells and antibodies. In contrast, higher baseline antibodies against the nonstructural protein 1 of multiple serotypes predicted early interferon and balanced immune activation, viremia control, and development of enduring, potent B and T cells, revealing how vaccines can induce broad, long-lasting protection. Last, individuals with potent and neutralizing antibodies and IFN-γ + T cells at baseline experienced minimal viral replication. Together, these findings demonstrate that controlled human challenge with dengue virus can delineate coordinated versus dysregulated acute immune responses and their effects on immunogenicity, informing therapeutic and vaccine strategies for dengue and other viral diseases.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to investigate how preexisting immunity influences dengue virus replication and immune responses. A phase 1 clinical trial with 45 healthy adults was conducted to compare outcomes of secondary infection challenge with a heterotypic, full-length, attenuated virus against primary and tertiary infections. The results showed that secondary infection led to greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. However, individuals with baseline antibodies that efficiently increased viral replication in vitro experienced delayed immune activation, high viremia, and waning of CD8+ T cells and antibodies. Higher baseline antibodies against nonstructural protein 1 of multiple serotypes were linked to early interferon responses, balanced immune activation, and viremia control. The study highlights the importance of preexisting immunity in shaping dengue outcomes and suggests that vaccines could induce broad, long-lasting protection. The findings demonstrate that controlled human challenge with dengue virus can help distinguish coordinated from dysregulated immune responses, offering insights for therapeutic and vaccine strategies. The evidence is strong, but the study's design and limited sample size may affect generalizability.

papers.title_zh: 登革病毒 人体受控挑战试验揭示了既往免疫力如何塑造病毒复制和广泛保护性免疫应答
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is the canonical viral disease for which immune history is a determinant of protective versus pathogenic responses and immunogenicity. Yet, because of limitations in animal models and clinical presentation after peak viremia, how preinfection and early immune responses affect dengue outcome is not confirmed. We conducted a phase 1 clinical trial with 45 healthy adults to test whether secondary infection challenge with a heterotypic, full-length, attenuated virus increases viremia and immunogenicity compared with primary and tertiary infection. Viremia was associated with more, but still mild, clinical signs and symptoms, and secondary infection resulted in greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. However, those whose baseline antibodies most efficiently increased dengue virus replication in an in vitro assay experienced delayed inflammatory and adaptive immune activation, the highest viremia, strong acute immune responses, and waning of potent CD8 + T cells and antibodies. In contrast, higher baseline antibodies against the nonstructural protein 1 of multiple serotypes predicted early interferon and balanced immune activation, viremia control, and development of enduring, potent B and T cells, revealing how vaccines can induce broad, long-lasting protection. Last, individuals with potent and neutralizing antibodies and IFN-γ + T cells at baseline experienced minimal viral replication. Together, these findings demonstrate that controlled human challenge with dengue virus can delineate coordinated versus dysregulated acute immune responses and their effects on immunogenicity, informing therapeutic and vaccine strategies for dengue and other viral diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是典型的病毒性疾病,其免疫史决定了保护性与致病性免疫应答及免疫原性。然而,由于动物模型和临床表现的局限性,尤其是在病毒血症高峰期之后,既往感染和早期 免疫应答 对登革热结果的影响尚未得到确认。我们开展了一项 I 期临床试验,纳入 45 名健康成年人,以测试与初次和三次感染相比,异型、全长、减毒病毒的二次感染挑战是否能增加病毒血症和免疫原性。病毒血症与更多但仍然轻微的临床症状相关,而二次感染导致更高的病毒血症、中和抗体水平和保护性 T 细胞应答。然而,那些基线抗体在体外试验中最有效地促进 登革病毒 复制的个体表现出延迟的炎症和适应性免疫激活、最高的病毒血症、强烈的急性 免疫应答 以及强效 CD8 + T 细胞和抗体的减弱。相反,对多种血清型非结构蛋白 1 具有较高基线抗体水平的个体则预测了早期干扰素产生、平衡的免疫激活、病毒血症控制以及持久且强效的 B 细胞和 T 细胞的发育,揭示了 疫苗 如何诱导广泛而持久的保护。最后,那些基线具有强效且中和抗体以及 IFN-γ + T 细胞的个体表现出最小的病毒复制。综上所述,这些发现表明,通过 登革病毒 进行的人体受控挑战试验能够区分急性 免疫应答 的协调与失调状态及其对免疫原性的影响,从而为登革热及其他病毒性疾病提供治疗和 疫苗 策略的依据。

papers.title: Metabolic Screening and In Silico Investigation of Eucalyptus globulus Essential Oil Bioactives Against DENV-2 Envelope Protein.
papers.abstract: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). Extensive research across both academic and industrial sectors has focused on various aspects of DENV, including its molecular virology, epidemiological patterns, transmission pathways, and therapeutic targets. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention. Nonetheless, emerging evidence has highlighted several limitations associated with current vaccination strategies, prompting a growing emphasis on the discovery and development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6. Toxicity and drug-likeness analyses confirmed the safety of the metabolites for drug development. These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. However, further in vivo studies using animal models are required to validate its therapeutic efficacy.

The research aimed to address the limitations of current dengue prevention strategies by exploring alternative therapeutic options. The findings revealed that Globulol and Ecalyptol exhibited higher binding affinity with DENV-2 receptors, suggesting their potential as antiviral agents. However, the study lacked in vivo validation, limiting the strength of the evidence. The results may contribute to the development of new treatments for dengue fever, particularly in the context of improving therapeutic options beyond existing vaccines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO).
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于桉树精油生物活性成分与DENV-2包膜蛋白的分子对接分析。研究涉及生物活性成分的识别及其与DENV-2靶点的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用了代谢筛选和计算机模拟技术,包括通过KEGG和Metascape进行的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及网络通路分析,以及分子对接分析以评估其与DENV-2受体的结合亲和力。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现共有14种主要的生物活性成分与登革热高度相关,产生了70个登革热与生物活性成分之间的共同靶点。通过KEGG和Metascape分析进行的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及网络通路分析显示,DENV-2靶点具有更高的相关性。分子对接分析表明,Globulol和Ecalyptol与DENV-2的两个受体1oke和1tg8具有更高的结合亲和力,结合能量分别为-8.3和-7.6。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,桉树精油可能在登革热的治疗中具有潜力。四价CYD-TDV(Dengvaxia)疫苗的开发标志着登革热预防的重要进展。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为开发抗病毒药物作为登革热管理的替代或补充治疗方案提供信息。本研究突出了天然生物活性成分在针对DENV-2进行治疗应用中的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告使用动物模型进行的体内研究或临床试验以验证桉树精油的治疗效果。这些证据基于计算机模拟分析,可能在预测实际结果方面存在局限性。

papers.title: Regional and Temporal Dynamics of Dengue in Mexico (2020-2024): A Comprehensive Epidemiological Analysis.
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.

The central question is to understand how dengue transmission patterns have evolved over this period and their implications for public health.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review utilizes national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024. It includes a comprehensive analysis of serotype-specific data, climatic factors, and hospitalization rates. The study design is based on observational epidemiological data, with no explicit mention of meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that dengue incidence and clinical burden have increased substantially in Mexico, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. It also notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases, while warning signs increased significantly. The findings highlight the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of dengue transmission across different regions and years.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a shift in predominant serotypes over time, with DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward. However, the exact mechanisms driving this shift are not fully explained. Additionally, the study notes that several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, but the reasons for these variations are not clearly addressed.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies due to the changing epidemiological landscape. It also suggests that further research is required to understand the factors contributing to the shift in serotype dominance and the reasons behind the atypical outbreaks in certain states.

elements_en.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the regional and temporal dynamics of dengue in Mexico from 2020 to 2024, examining geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. The central question is to understand how dengue transmission patterns have evolved over this period and their implications for public health.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review utilizes national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024. It includes a comprehensive analysis of serotype-specific data, climatic factors, and hospitalization rates. The study design is based on observational epidemiological data, with no explicit mention of meta-analysis or consensus processes.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that dengue incidence and clinical burden have increased substantially in Mexico, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. It also notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases, while warning signs increased significantly. The findings highlight the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of dengue transmission across different regions and years.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a shift in predominant serotypes over time, with DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward. However, the exact mechanisms driving this shift are not fully explained. Additionally, the study notes that several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, but the reasons for these variations are not clearly addressed.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies due to the changing epidemiological landscape. It also suggests that further research is required to understand the factors contributing to the shift in serotype dominance and the reasons behind the atypical outbreaks in certain states.

papers.title_zh: 墨西哥2020-2024年登革热的区域与时间动态:一项全面的流行病学分析。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是墨西哥的主要公共卫生问题,近年来其流行程度和临床负担显著增加。本研究利用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化,重点分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。在这一时期,墨西哥的登革热病例数几乎增加了五倍,2024年达到超过123,000例确诊病例和426例死亡,这是有记录以来最高的年度病例数。季节性模式发生了变化,持续的登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。血清型数据揭示了主要病毒血清型的变化,DENV2在2022年之前占主导地位,DENV1在2021年达到高峰,而DENV3则从2022年开始急剧上升,成为2023年的主导血清型,并在2024年几乎成为唯一流行的血清型。这种变化与登革热病例数的持续上升以及警告信号的增加(从2020年的16.9%上升到2023-2024年的>42%)相吻合,同时医院入院率也显著提高,而重症登革热病例仍低于5%。尽管DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则在南部和北部地区偶有流行。一些传统上登革热流行率较低的州出现了非典型的流行模式,突显了登革热暴发可能突然扩展的潜在风险。气候分析显示,温度与DENV3的流行率之间存在一致的正相关关系,而降水的影响则因年份而异。比值比分析表明,不同血清型在不同年份的严重程度存在差异。这些发现突显了墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,并强调了制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略的必要性。

papers.title: Epidemiological, clinical, and diagnostic characteristics of a large-scale upsurge of dengue in the rohingya refugee camps and host communities in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, 2021 to 2024: A retrospective study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue emerged as a new public health threat in the Rohingya refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, in 2021 and expanded into large-scale upsurges in subsequent years. Evidence on dengue epidemiology and clinical presentation in protracted refugee settings remains limited, despite the need for stronger outbreak preparedness and case management in these contexts. OBJECTIVES: To describe the epidemiological, clinical, and diagnostic characteristics of the dengue upsurge among Rohingya refugees and surrounding host communities in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, and to identify predictors of inpatient admission and diagnostic positivity patterns. METHODS: This retrospective observational study used anonymized surveillance data from the International Organization for Migration (IOM) dengue patient database. Rapid diagnostic test (RDT)-confirmed dengue cases identified across 36 IOM-supported health facilities in Ukhiya and Teknaf between 1 October 2021 and 31 December 2024 were included. Demographic, epidemiological, clinical, and laboratory variables were summarized using descriptive statistics. Weekly case counts were aggregated by epidemiological week and calendar year, and epidemic growth and decay phases were modelled using phase-specific Poisson regression. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with inpatient admission, while separate models examined associations between delay in presentation and RDT positivity patterns, adjusting for age and sex. RESULTS: A total of 35,581 RDT-confirmed dengue cases were reported, of which 90.2% occurred among Rohingya refugees. The median age was 17 years (IQR 7-30), and 46.0% of cases were among children aged 0-14 years. Annual caseload increased from 1,011 in 2021-11,752 in 2022, 10,669 in 2023 and 12,149 in 2024, with seasonal peaks during the monsoon period and progressively later peaks and longer epidemic tails over time. Poisson models showed decreasing growth rates across years (r = 0.449 in 2021 to r = 0.091 in 2024) with increasing doubling times, while decay rates remained broadly comparable (halving time ~4.4-6.0 weeks). Overall, 8.0% of cases required inpatient admission, 1.3% were referred, and four deaths were reported (case fatality <0.1%). In multivariable analysis, inpatient admission was associated with older age (≥60 vs 0-14: aOR 2.48), delayed presentation (aOR 1.06 per day), refugee status (aOR 1.43), fever ≥38°C at presentation (aOR 1.13), presence of any WHO warning sign (aOR 28.87), and chronic co-morbidity (aOR 6.63). Males had lower odds of admission than females (aOR 0.87). CONCLUSION: Sustained dengue preparedness is required in Cox's Bazar, including strengthened surveillance, community-based early referral, targeted monitoring of high-risk groups, environmental vector control, and phase-appropriate use of NS1 and IgM/IgG diagnostics to reduce missed diagnoses and prevent progression to severe disease. These findings highlight the need for a policy shift from episodic outbreak response toward sustained dengue preparedness in humanitarian settings, including strengthened surveillance systems, integrated diagnostic strategies, community-based early referral, and coordinated vector control interventions.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在人道主义环境中,需要从间歇性的暴发反应转向持续的登革热防控政策,包括加强监测系统、整合诊断策略、基于社区的早期转诊以及协调的媒介控制干预措施。

papers.title: Transmission Dynamics of Dengue Virus, Ceará State, Brazil, 2010-2025.
papers.abstract: We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010-2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation.

papers.title: Dengue virus-2 triggers Epstein-Barr virus replication in primary B cells by co-opting the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The intricate interplay between co-infecting viral pathogens within a host can significantly influence disease outcomes. Dengue virus (DENV), a globally prevalent arbovirus from the Flaviviridae family, and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), a ubiquitous human herpesvirus, share extensive geographical overlap, yet their potential interactions remain largely uncharacterized. This study elucidates a novel molecular mechanism whereby DENV-2 infection triggers disruption of EBV latency. We systematically demonstrate that DENV-2 infection consistently induces EBV lytic gene expression and viral replication in diverse cellular contexts, including epithelial cell lines and, critically, in primary human B lymphocytes—the principal reservoir of latent EBV. Mechanistically, we establish that the substantial burden of DENV-2 protein synthesis and replication induces profound endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, activating the unfolded protein response (UPR). Through pharmacological inhibition and genetic knockdown, we dissect the three UPR branches and identify the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis as the indispensable pathway for this phenomenon. DENV-2 infection promotes the endoribonuclease activity of IRE1, leading to the unconventional splicing of XBP1 mRNA into its transcriptionally active isoform, XBP1s. Depletion of IRE1 or XBP1 attenuated DENV-induced BZLF1 expression, whereas ectopic XBP1s expression increased BZLF1 transcription. Our findings delineate a precise virus-host-virus signaling model in which an acute RNA virus engages a cellular stress pathway to promote entry into the EBV lytic program and viral genome amplification. This provides a new paradigm for understanding the pathobiology of dengue fever and the complex dynamics of the human virome. IMPORTANCE This research uncovers a previously unrecognized molecular dialog between two of the world’s most common viral pathogens. By demonstrating that dengue virus infection can awaken dormant Epstein-Barr virus, this study provides a mechanistic basis for the long-suspected but poorly understood complications arising from viral co-infections. We pinpoint a specific cellular stress pathway, the IRE1-XBP1 axis of the unfolded protein response (UPR), as the critical molecular switch. This discovery is significant because it not only explains how an acute viral illness can trigger the reactivation of a latent, potentially oncogenic virus but also opens new avenues for therapeutic intervention. Understanding this intricate interplay could lead to novel strategies for managing severe dengue and other diseases where viral co-infection is a contributing factor to pathogenesis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study investigates the potential interactions between Dengue virus (DENV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), focusing on how DENV might influence EBV latency and replication. The research is motivated by the need to understand the complex dynamics of viral co-infections and their impact on disease outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a laboratory setting using diverse cellular contexts, including epithelial cell lines and primary human B lymphocytes, which are the principal reservoir of latent EBV. The research involved systematic analysis of DENV-2 infection effects on EBV.
analysis.methods: The study employed pharmacological inhibition and genetic knockdown techniques to dissect the unfolded protein response (UPR) branches and identify the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis as the pathway involved. It also included experiments to assess the impact of DENV-2 on EBV lytic gene expression and replication.
analysis.main_results: DENV-2 infection was shown to consistently induce EBV lytic gene expression and viral replication in both epithelial cell lines and primary human B lymphocytes. Depletion of IRE1 or XBP1 reduced DENV-induced BZLF1 expression, while ectopic XBP1s expression increased BZLF1 transcription.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence of a novel molecular mechanism by which DENV-2 infection triggers EBV reactivation through the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis. This discovery provides a new understanding of how viral co-infections can influence pathogenesis.

papers.title_zh: 登革病毒-2通过劫持IRE1-XBP1信号轴在原代B细胞中触发Epstein-Barr病毒复制。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT The intricate interplay between co-infecting viral pathogens within a host can significantly influence disease outcomes. Dengue virus (DENV), a globally prevalent arbovirus from the Flaviviridae family, and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), a ubiquitous human herpesvirus, share extensive geographical overlap, yet their potential interactions remain largely uncharacterized. This study elucidates a novel molecular mechanism whereby DENV-2 infection triggers disruption of EBV latency. We systematically demonstrate that DENV-2 infection consistently induces EBV lytic gene expression and viral replication in diverse cellular contexts, including epithelial cell lines and, critically, in primary human B lymphocytes—the principal reservoir of latent EBV. Mechanistically, we establish that the substantial burden of DENV-2 protein synthesis and replication induces profound endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, activating the unfolded protein response (UPR). Through pharmacological inhibition and genetic knockdown, we dissect the three UPR branches and identify the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis as the indispensable pathway for this phenomenon. DENV-2 infection promotes the endoribonuclease activity of IRE1, leading to the unconventional splicing of XBP1 mRNA into its transcriptionally active isoform, XBP1s. Depletion of IRE1 or XBP1 attenuated DENV-induced BZLF1 expression, whereas ectopic XBP1s expression increased BZLF1 transcription. Our findings delineate a precise virus-host-virus signaling model in which an acute RNA virus engages a cellular stress pathway to promote entry into the EBV lytic program and viral genome amplification. This provides a new paradigm for understanding the pathobiology of dengue fever and the complex dynamics of the human virome. IMPORTANCE This research uncovers a previously unrecognized molecular dialog between two of the world’s most common viral pathogens. By demonstrating that dengue virus infection can awaken dormant Epstein-Barr virus, this study provides a mechanistic basis for the long-suspected but poorly understood complications arising from viral co-infections. We pinpoint a specific cellular stress pathway, the IRE1-XBP1 axis of the unfolded protein response (UPR), as the critical molecular switch. This discovery is significant because it not only explains how an acute viral illness can trigger the reactivation of a latent, potentially oncogenic virus but also opens new avenues for therapeutic intervention. Understanding this intricate interplay could lead to novel strategies for managing severe dengue and other diseases where viral co-infection is a contributing factor to pathogenesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在宿主中,共感染的病毒病原体之间的复杂相互作用可能显著影响疾病结果。登革病毒(DENV)是一种在全球范围内广泛流行的黄病毒科病毒,而Epstein-Barr病毒(EBV)是一种普遍的人类疱疹病毒,两者在地理分布上存在广泛重叠,但它们之间的潜在相互作用仍知之甚少。本研究阐明了一种新的分子机制,即DENV-2感染会触发EBV潜伏状态的破坏。我们系统地证明了DENV-2感染在多种细胞背景下,包括上皮细胞系和关键的原代人类B淋巴细胞——EBV潜伏的主要宿主——中,能够持续诱导EBV裂解基因表达和病毒复制。从机制上讲,我们确定DENV-2蛋白合成和复制的大量负担会引发内质网(ER)应激,激活未折叠蛋白反应(UPR)。通过药理学抑制和基因沉默,我们解析了UPR的三个分支,并确定IRE1-XBP1信号轴是这一现象的关键途径。DENV-2感染促进IRE1的内切核糖核酸酶活性,导致XBP1 mRNA发生非常规剪接,生成具有转录活性的XBP1s异构体。IRE1或XBP1的耗竭会减弱DENV诱导的BZLF1表达,而过表达XBP1s则会增加BZLF1的转录。我们的研究结果描绘了一个精确的病毒-宿主-病毒信号模型,其中急性RNA病毒通过激活细胞应激通路促进EBV裂解程序的启动和病毒复制。这一发现为理解登革热的病原生物学以及人类病毒组的复杂动态提供了新的范式。重要性 本研究揭示了两种全球最常见病毒病原体之间此前未被认识的分子对话。通过证明登革病毒感染能够唤醒潜伏的Epstein-Barr病毒,本研究为病毒共感染可能导致的长期怀疑但尚未明确的并发症提供了机制依据。我们确定了特定的细胞应激通路——未折叠蛋白反应(UPR)的IRE1-XBP1轴——作为关键的分子开关。这一发现具有重要意义,因为它不仅解释了急性病毒感染如何触发潜伏的、可能致癌的病毒重新激活,还为治疗干预开辟了新的途径。理解这种复杂的相互作用可能有助于制定新的策略,以管理重症登革热及其他与病毒共感染相关的疾病。

papers.title: Molecular epidemiology of dengue virus in the Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, during the COVID-19 pandemic.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a major global health challenge with a rising number of infections worldwide. In Indonesia, molecular epidemiological studies have been limited, focusing primarily on Java Island, which has led to a sufficiency in comprehensive data of DENV characteristics. During the COVID-19 pandemic, fewer DENV epidemiological studies were conducted, further leaving a gap in our understanding of viral circulation during this period. Characterization of DENV serotypes, genotypes, and nucleotide substitutions is essential for improving clinical management and informing vaccine strategies. This study employed a cross-sectional design with consecutive sampling of suspected dengue patients from a private clinic and hospital in Bangka-Belitung, Indonesia, between 2019 and 2023. Patients with fever and two or more clinical symptoms of DENV infection were included. DENV infection was confirmed by NS1 antigen test, and positive samples were further analyzed for DENV serotypes by RT-PCR, followed by envelope gene analysis for phylogenetic characterization. Out of 92 suspected dengue infections, 74 cases (80.43%) were confirmed for DENV infection via RT-PCR, NS-1, or IgM antibody tests, with the majority of confirmed dengue cases occurred in children. DENV-3 was found to be the most dominant serotype (38.71%), followed by DENV-1 (11.83%), which aligns with previous studies characterizing the serotypes of circulating DENV strains. Phylogenetic analysis of DENV (1-4) during the COVID-19 pandemic revealed that these strains clustered into a distinct groups under the same genotypes as earlier outbreaks. This molecular epidemiology and seroprevalence data provide valuable insight into the circulating DENV strains in Indonesia. AUTHOR SUMMARY: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health problem in Indonesia, one of the countries with the highest dengue burden worldwide. Although DENV is endemic throughout the Indonesian archipelago, information on the genetic diversity and circulation of DENV is still limited in many regions outside Java Island. Bangka Belitung Province is an understudied area where molecular epidemiological data are largely unavailable, making it difficult to understand local transmission patterns and support evidence-based control strategies. In this study, we investigated DENV infections in Bangka Belitung before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. We analyzed clinical samples from patients with suspected DENV infection to determine circulating serotypes and genetic characteristics of the virus. All four DENV serotypes were detected, with DENV-3 identified as the predominant serotype throughout the study period. Phylogenetic analyses showed that the circulating viruses belonged to genotypes that have been reported previously in Indonesia, indicating ongoing endemic transmission and genetic diversity within the country. Our findings provide the first comprehensive molecular epidemiological data on DENV circulation in Bangka Belitung. These results contribute to a better understanding of dengue transmission dynamics in Indonesia and highlight the importance of continuous molecular surveillance to detect viral introductions, monitor genetic changes, and support DENV prevention and control programs.

These results contribute to a better understanding of dengue transmission dynamics in Indonesia and highlight the importance of continuous molecular surveillance to detect viral introductions, monitor genetic changes, and support DENV prevention and control programs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(DENV)感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其全球感染人数持续上升。本研究旨在填补印度尼西亚关于DENV分子流行病学数据的空白,特别是在邦加-勿里洞群岛。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用横断面研究设计,于2019年至2023年间在印度尼西亚邦加-勿里洞群岛的私人诊所和医院中连续采集疑似登革热患者的样本。纳入标准为具有发热症状以及至少两个登革热临床症状的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过NS1抗原检测确认DENV感染,阳性样本进一步通过RT-PCR分析确定DENV血清型,并通过包膜基因分析进行系统发育特征分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在92例疑似登革热感染病例中,有74例(80.43%)通过RT-PCR、NS-1或IgM抗体检测确认为DENV感染,其中大多数确诊病例发生在儿童中。所有四种DENV血清型均被检测到,其中DENV-3在整个研究期间被确认为主要血清型。系统发育分析显示,传播的病毒株属于此前在印度尼西亚报道过的基因型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,DENV在印度尼西亚持续地方性流行并具有遗传多样性,其中DENV-3是最常见的血清型。本研究为邦加-勿里洞地区的DENV传播提供了首个全面的分子流行病学数据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于更好地理解印度尼西亚登革热的传播动态,并强调了持续进行分子监测的重要性,以检测病毒引入、监测遗传变化并支持DENV的预防和控制计划。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面研究设计,以及某些人群可能被低估的代表性。由于研究基于单一地点和时间段,其证据强度中等。

papers.title: circEPSTI1 regulates miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1 signaling axis to enhance dengue infection and is suppressed by Tiplaxtinin.
papers.abstract: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have recently been identified as crucial regulators of gene expression in various diseases. Their role in dengue remains unexplored. In this study, circEPSTI1 induction was observed in peripheral blood mononuclear cells and plasma of dengue patients. The induction of circEPSTI1 is interferon-dependent and enhances DENV infection by sponging the expression of miR-942-5p. The antiviral role of miR-942-5p is mediated by bidirectional inhibition through targeting conserved genomic sequences of the DENV genome of different subtypes across NS1, NS3, and NS5 and the host AKT1 signaling pathway. RNA-seq analysis of DENV-infected circEPSTI1 knockdown A549 cells identified SERPINE1 and AKT1 signaling pathways to be dysregulated significantly. circEPSTI1 relieves the inhibition of miR-942-5p over DENV genomic RNA and the host SERPINE1 to activate AKT1 signaling. The activation of AKT1 signaling facilitates cell survival and enhances DENV replication. The expression of SERPINE1 and circEPSTI1 was upregulated in Dengue patients, and pharmaceutical inhibition of SERPINE1 through Tiplaxtinin inhibits the DENV replication by reducing the expression of circEPSTI1. Overall, our result demonstrates the therapeutic potential of Tiplaxtinin by targeting the circEPSTI1-miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1 axis in dengue treatment.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the role of circular RNAs (circRNAs) in dengue infection, given their recent identification as crucial regulators of gene expression in various diseases and the unexplored role of circRNAs in dengue.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved peripheral blood mononuclear cells and plasma from dengue patients, with RNA-seq analysis of DENV-infected circEPSTI1 knockdown A549 cells.
analysis.methods: The study used RNA-seq to analyze DENV-infected circEPSTI1 knockdown A549 cells, identifying dysregulated SERPINE1 and AKT1 signaling pathways. CircEPSTI1 was induced in dengue patients and its role in enhancing DENV infection was investigated.
analysis.main_results: CircEPSTI1 induction was observed in dengue patients and was found to enhance DENV infection by sponging miR-942-5p. RNA-seq analysis of DENV-infected circEPSTI1 knockdown A549 cells identified SERPINE1 and AKT1 signaling pathways as dysregulated. Tiplaxtinin, which inhibits SERPINE1, reduced DENV replication by decreasing circEPSTI1 expression.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that circEPSTI1 relieves the inhibition of miR-942-5p over DENV genomic RNA and SERPINE1, activating AKT1 signaling, which facilitates cell survival and enhances DENV replication. Tiplaxtinin has therapeutic potential by targeting this axis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting the circEPSTI1-miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1 axis could be a potential therapeutic strategy for dengue treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of cell lines and the need for further validation in vivo. The evidence strength is moderate due to the use of in vitro models.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨环状RNA(circRNAs)在登革病毒感染中的作用,鉴于其最近被鉴定为多种疾病中基因表达的关键调控因子,而circRNAs在登革病毒中的作用尚未被探索。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及登革热患者的外周血单核细胞和血浆,并对外周血单核细胞中DENV感染的circEPSTI1敲低A549细胞进行了RNA-seq分析。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用RNA-seq分析DENV感染的circEPSTI1敲低A549细胞,识别出SERPINE1和AKT1信号通路的失调。在登革热患者中诱导了circEPSTI1,并研究了其在增强DENV感染中的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 在登革热患者中观察到circEPSTI1的诱导,并发现其通过海绵吸附miR-942-5p来增强DENV感染。对DENV感染的circEPSTI1敲低A549细胞进行RNA-seq分析,发现SERPINE1和AKT1信号通路显著失调。Tiplaxtinin通过抑制SERPINE1,减少了circEPSTI1的表达,从而抑制了DENV复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究证明,circEPSTI1通过缓解miR-942-5p对DENV基因组RNA和SERPINE1的抑制,激活AKT1信号通路,从而促进细胞存活并增强DENV复制。Tiplaxtinin通过靶向这一轴具有治疗潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,靶向circEPSTI1-miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1轴可能是治疗登革热的一种潜在策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了细胞系,需要在体内进一步验证。由于使用了体外模型,证据强度中等。

Overall, our result demonstrates the therapeutic potential of Tiplaxtinin by targeting the circEPSTI1-miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1 axis in dengue treatment.

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

source_records.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在从植物来源的天然产物中鉴定新型抗病毒药物化合物,以应对针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV))的特异性抗病毒药物疗法的未满足需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过功能实验评估提取物的抗病毒药物活性,从而分离并表征四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷。
analysis_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了DENV-2的感染性,在非细胞毒性浓度下,Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.实现了完全抑制。分离出的化合物抑制了DENV的复制,这表现在病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的明显下降。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果确定了螺甾烷皂苷作为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物,对ZIKV和CHIKV具有跨属病毒的疗效。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发针对登革热和其他虫媒病毒的新抗病毒药物疗法,从而潜在地减少这些感染对全球公共卫生的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用非随机的体外方法,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。由于研究结果尚处于初步阶段,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
papers.abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. papers.title_zh: 对 登革病毒 衣壳蛋白构象动力学的计算见解。

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中发挥重要作用,包括 基因组 的衣壳化、脂滴的招募和颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋,它在这些功能以及闭合和开放构象之间的转换中发挥着核心作用。这项工作研究了衣壳蛋白的构象变化途径,特别是如何控制控制疏水袋打开和关闭的分子机制。通过结合使用不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强的采样方法,我们分享了对在控制这些转变中发挥关键作用的结构重排的见解。我们的结果表明,脂质结合通过环境因素调节疏水袋的可及性。在开放构象中,口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象可以保护疏水袋免受周围水介质的影响,同时还可以防止溶液相中过早的相互作用,从而破坏蛋白质的稳定性。这些见解使人们能够深入了解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学,并为旨在干扰其功能转变的 抗病毒药物 策略提供了一组有前景的有效靶标。

papers.title: Economic Evaluation of an E-Dengue Early Warning System for Proactive Dengue Prevention in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam: A Protocol
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Numerous dengue early warning tools have been developed, while few have been successfully integrated into routine surveillance systems. The E-Dengue tool, designed using the "Useful, Usable, and Used" framework, aims to predict dengue epidemics three months in advance in the Mekong Delta Region (MDR) of Vietnam. This protocol outlines the economic evaluation of an early warning system in which E-Dengue alerts prompt proactive dengue prevention and control interventions. METHODS: An economic evaluation using a societal perspective will be conducted alongside a cluster-randomized controlled trial. Costs and outcomes will be compared between the E-Dengue early warning system and routine practice. The primary outcome measure will be disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and the secondary outcome measure will be dengue cases. The mean cost of a dengue case will be quantified by conducting a cost of illness substudy that will utilize both hospital billing records and structured surveys of patients and informal caregivers and by evidence synthesis from the literature. The cost-effectiveness of E-Dengue will be assessed over a 2-year time horizon and expressed as the incremental cost per DALY averted and per dengue case averted, respectively, and compared against a prespecified cost-effectiveness threshold. The robustness of the results will be evaluated using one-way and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. DISCUSSION: Demonstrating that E-Dengue is cost-effective will provide rigorous evidence to support its integration into routine surveillance in the MDR and potentially for it to be scaled up and adapted to other areas of Vietnam and nations with similar conditions. Conversely, if E-Dengue is not cost-effective, the study will provide critical lessons for the design and implementation of future early warning tools. TRIAL REGISTRATION NO: ACTRN12626000402347.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the economic feasibility of integrating an early warning system, E-Dengue, into routine surveillance to predict dengue epidemics in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam. Few dengue early warning tools have been successfully integrated into routine surveillance systems, highlighting the need for rigorous evaluation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study will conduct an economic evaluation using a societal perspective alongside a cluster-randomized controlled trial, comparing the E-Dengue early warning system to routine practice in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam.
analysis.methods: The economic evaluation will compare costs and outcomes between the E-Dengue early warning system and routine practice. Costs will be quantified through a cost of illness substudy using hospital billing records and structured surveys, and outcomes will be measured in terms of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and dengue cases. The cost-effectiveness will be assessed using a 2-year time horizon and compared against a prespecified cost-effectiveness threshold. Sensitivity analyses will be conducted to evaluate the robustness of the results.
analysis.main_results: The study will directly observe the economic impact of the E-Dengue early warning system compared to routine practice, including costs and outcomes such as DALYs and dengue cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Demonstrating that E-Dengue is cost-effective will provide rigorous evidence to support its integration into routine surveillance in the Mekong Delta Region and potentially for scaling up and adaptation to other areas. Conversely, if E-Dengue is not cost-effective, the study will provide critical lessons for the design and implementation of future early warning tools.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings will inform the integration of E-Dengue into routine surveillance, potentially reducing the burden of dengue cases and improving public health outcomes in the Mekong Delta Region and similar areas.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a cluster-randomized controlled trial, which may introduce bias, and the reliance on cost and outcome measures that may not fully capture the economic impact. The evidence strength is moderate due to the use of a societal perspective and the assessment of cost-effectiveness over a 2-year time horizon.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the economic feasibility of integrating the E-Dengue early warning system into routine surveillance in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam, by comparing costs and outcomes with routine practice. The findings will inform the integration of E-Dengue and potentially its adaptation to other areas.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估将E-Dengue早期预警系统整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中以预测登革热疫情的经济可行性。仅有少数登革热早期预警工具成功整合到常规监测系统中,这凸显了进行严谨评估的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将采用社会视角进行经济评估,并与集群随机对照试验同时进行,比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规做法。
elements_zh.methods: 经济评估将比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法的成本和结果。成本将通过一项疾病成本子研究进行量化,该研究将利用医院账单记录和结构化调查,结果将通过伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数进行衡量。成本效益将通过2年的时间范围进行评估,并与预设的成本效益阈值进行比较。将进行敏感性分析以评估结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究将直接观察E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法相比的经济影响,包括成本和结果,如伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 证明E-Dengue具有成本效益将为将其整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中提供严谨的证据,并可能为在其他地区推广和适应该系统提供支持。相反,如果E-Dengue不具成本效益,本研究将为未来早期预警工具的设计和实施提供关键的教训。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果将为将E-Dengue整合到常规监测系统提供信息,可能减少登革热病例负担并改善湄公河三角洲地区及其他类似地区的公共卫生结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用集群随机对照试验,这可能引入偏倚,以及依赖可能无法完全反映经济影响的成本和结果指标。由于采用社会视角并评估2年时间范围内的成本效益,证据强度为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:尽管已开发出多种登革热早期预警工具,但仅有少数成功整合到常规监测系统中。E-Dengue工具采用"有用、可用、被使用"框架设计,旨在提前三个月预测越南湄公河三角洲地区(MDR)的登革热疫情。本方案概述了对早期预警系统进行经济评估的过程,该系统通过E-Dengue警报触发主动的登革热预防和控制干预措施。方法:将采用社会视角进行经济评估,并与集群随机对照试验同时进行。将比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法的成本和结果。主要结果指标为伤残调整生命年(DALYs),次要结果指标为登革热病例数。通过开展一项疾病成本子研究,量化每例登革热病例的平均成本,该研究将结合医院账单记录、患者和非正式护理者的结构化调查以及文献中的证据综合分析。E-Dengue的成本效益将在2年的时间范围内进行评估,并以每避免一个DALY和每避免一例登革热病例的增量成本分别表达,并与预设的成本效益阈值进行比较。结果的稳健性将通过单变量和概率敏感性分析进行评估。讨论:证明E-Dengue具有成本效益将为将其整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中提供严谨的证据,并可能为在越南其他地区以及具有类似条件的国家推广和适应该系统提供支持。相反,如果E-Dengue不具成本效益,该研究将为未来早期预警工具的设计和实施提供关键的教训。试验注册号:ACTRN12626000402347。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估将E-Dengue早期预警系统整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中以预测登革热疫情的经济可行性。仅有少数登革热早期预警工具成功整合到常规监测系统中,这凸显了进行严谨评估的必要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将采用社会视角进行经济评估,并与集群随机对照试验同时进行,比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规做法。
analysis_zh.methods: 经济评估将比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法的成本和结果。成本将通过一项疾病成本子研究进行量化,该研究将利用医院账单记录和结构化调查,结果将通过伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数进行衡量。成本效益将通过2年的时间范围进行评估,并与预设的成本效益阈值进行比较。将进行敏感性分析以评估结果的稳健性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究将直接观察E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法相比的经济影响,包括成本和结果,如伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 证明E-Dengue具有成本效益将为将其整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中提供严谨的证据,并可能为在其他地区推广和适应该系统提供支持。相反,如果E-Dengue不具成本效益,本研究将为未来早期预警工具的设计和实施提供关键的教训。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果将为将E-Dengue整合到常规监测系统提供信息,可能减少登革热病例负担并改善湄公河三角洲地区及其他类似地区的公共卫生结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用集群随机对照试验,这可能引入偏倚,以及依赖可能无法完全反映经济影响的成本和结果指标。由于采用社会视角并评估2年时间范围内的成本效益,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Cardiac Involvement in Patients with Dengue Fever: A Clinical Analysis.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: The highest incidence of dengue fever (DF) is seen in Southeast Asia, India, and the American tropics. Arboviruses represent a serious public health problem in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. Although dengue shock syndrome (DSS) has been attributed largely to decreased intravascular volume due to capillary leakage of plasma into the interstitial space, a few recent studies have reported that it may be due to cardiac involvement. Hence, the present study was planned to assess the cardiac manifestations of DF and to identify subclinical/latent cardiac involvement. Aims and Objectives: To study was to evaluate the various cardiac manifestations of DF along with its prevalence. Materials and Methods: This descriptive cross-sectional study evaluated the prevalence and severity correlation of cardiac manifestations in dengue fever patients at a rural tertiary care center between January and December 2025. A total of 110 patients aged 13 years and older with confirmed dengue serology were enrolled after providing written informed consent. The study excluded individuals with pre-existing heart conditions, electrolyte imbalances, mixed infections, or medications affecting heart rate and rhythm. Data collection involved detailed clinical histories, daily vital sign monitoring, complete blood counts, cardiac enzyme assays, electrocardiograms, and 2D echocardiograms conducted after fever resolution. Cardiac involvement was identified through rhythm disturbances, enzyme elevations, and structural or electrical abnormalities, with patients classified according to WHO criteria following ethical approval. Results: In this study, out of the eight patients with DSS, six patients (75%) had positive troponin I. Eight patients were found to have DSS with 87.5% of them having raised CKMB levels compared to 42.3% and 39.5% in dengue hemorrhagic fever and DF, respectively. Conclusion: Cardiac involvement in dengue can contribute to hemodynamic instability in dengue patients. ECG can prove a useful tool, especially in patients with hemodynamic instability to plan for more efficient management.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和单一中心设置,这可能影响其结果的普遍性。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于登革热患者心脏受累的具体发现,但缺乏更广泛的验证。

papers.title: A Live Attenuated Dengue Virus Vaccine (Dengvaxia) is Suppressed in Individuals with Immunity to Serotype 4
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengvaxia® was the first live attenuated tetravalent dengue virus (DENV) vaccine to be tested and approved for use in people. While Dengvaxia was designed to be tetravalent, in humans, the vaccine performed like a monovalent DENV4 vaccine because the DENV4 vaccine virus replicated better than other vaccine serotypes. Dengvaxia® was safe and efficacious in children who were DENV-immune at baseline and contraindicated for use in DENV-naïve children. Methods When Dengvaxia® was rolled out as a pediatric vaccine in the Philippines in 2016, we established a prospective cohort to assess vaccine performance by baseline dengue serostatus. Here we report on how baseline monotypic immunity to each serotype (reflecting one past DENV infection) impacted Dengvaxia® responses. Results We observed that in children with baseline immunity to DENV1, 2 or 3, the vaccine stimulated a secondary serotype cross-neutralizing Ab response, which likely explains the overall favorable performance of the vaccine in seropositive children enrolled in phase 3 trials. We observed a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression among DENV4 monotypic immune children. Conclusions Our results confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 vaccine component in Dengvaxia® and directly implicate pre-existing DENV4 immunity in the suppression of the vaccine. Our results have broader implications for evaluating the performance of other DENV vaccines in seropositive individuals.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate how baseline immunity to specific dengue serotypes affects the performance of the Dengvaxia® vaccine, addressing the knowledge gap about vaccine efficacy in seropositive individuals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a prospective cohort established in the Philippines in 2016 to assess Dengvaxia® performance based on baseline dengue serostatus, focusing on children with immunity to DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, or DENV4.
analysis.methods: The researchers evaluated vaccine responses in children with baseline immunity to each dengue serotype by analyzing neutralizing antibody (Ab) responses and vaccine replication dynamics.
analysis.main_results: The study found that children with baseline immunity to DENV4 had a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression, while those with immunity to other serotypes showed secondary cross-neutralizing Ab responses.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results directly implicate pre-existing DENV4 immunity in vaccine suppression and confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 component in Dengvaxia®.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings have broader implications for evaluating the performance of other dengue vaccines in seropositive individuals, particularly highlighting the need to consider serotype-specific immune responses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single geographic region and a specific vaccine, but the evidence is strong due to its direct observation of vaccine suppression in DENV4-immune children.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how baseline immunity to specific dengue serotypes affects the performance of the Dengvaxia® vaccine. It reports that children with immunity to DENV4 experienced high vaccine suppression, while those with immunity to other serotypes showed cross-neutralizing antibody responses. The findings confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 vaccine component and highlight the importance of serotype-specific immune responses in vaccine efficacy. These results have implications for evaluating other dengue vaccines in seropositive individuals. The study is based on a prospective cohort in the Philippines and is limited by its focus on a single vaccine and region, but the evidence is strong due to direct observations of vaccine suppression in DENV4-immune children.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在菲律宾于2016年建立的前瞻性队列研究,旨在根据基线登革病毒血清状态评估Dengvaxia®的表现,重点关注对DENV1、DENV2、DENV3或DENV4具有免疫力的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过分析中和抗体(Ab)反应和疫苗复制动力学,评估了对每种登革病毒血清型具有基线免疫力的儿童中疫苗的反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,对DENV4具有基线免疫力的儿童中,疫苗被抑制的频率很高(61%),而对其他血清型具有免疫力的儿童则表现出二次交叉中和抗体反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果直接指出先前的DENV4免疫力与疫苗被抑制之间的关联,并确认了Dengvaxia®中DENV4成分的复制优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对评估其他登革病毒疫苗在血清阳性个体中的表现具有更广泛的意义,特别是强调了需要考虑血清型特异性疫苗接种的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其仅限于单一地理区域和特定疫苗,但证据强度较高,因为直接观察到了对DENV4具有免疫力的儿童中疫苗被抑制的现象。

analysis_en.methods: The researchers evaluated vaccine responses in children with baseline immunity to each dengue serotype by analyzing neutralizing antibody (Ab) responses and vaccine replication dynamics.
analysis_en.main_results: The study found that children with baseline immunity to DENV4 had a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression, while those with immunity to other serotypes showed secondary cross-neutralizing Ab responses.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The results directly implicate pre-existing DENV4 immunity in vaccine suppression and confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 component in Dengvaxia®.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings have broader implications for evaluating the performance of other dengue vaccines in seropositive individuals, particularly highlighting the need to consider serotype-specific immune responses.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single geographic region and a specific vaccine, but the evidence is strong due to its direct observation of vaccine suppression in DENV4-immune children.

papers.title_zh: 一种活疫苗登革病毒(Dengvaxia)在对第4型登革病毒具有免疫力的个体中被抑制
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Dengvaxia® was the first live attenuated tetravalent dengue virus (DENV) vaccine to be tested and approved for use in people. While Dengvaxia was designed to be tetravalent, in humans, the vaccine performed like a monovalent DENV4 vaccine because the DENV4 vaccine virus replicated better than other vaccine serotypes. Dengvaxia® was safe and efficacious in children who were DENV-immune at baseline and contraindicated for use in DENV-naïve children. Methods When Dengvaxia® was rolled out as a pediatric vaccine in the Philippines in 2016, we established a prospective cohort to assess vaccine performance by baseline dengue serostatus. Here we report on how baseline monotypic immunity to each serotype (reflecting one past DENV infection) impacted Dengvaxia® responses. Results We observed that in children with baseline immunity to DENV1, 2 or 3, the vaccine stimulated a secondary serotype cross-neutralizing Ab response, which likely explains the overall favorable performance of the vaccine in seropositive children enrolled in phase 3 trials. We observed a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression among DENV4 monotypic immune children. Conclusions Our results confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 vaccine component in Dengvaxia® and directly implicate pre-existing DENV4 immunity in the suppression of the vaccine. Our results have broader implications for evaluating the performance of other DENV vaccines in seropositive individuals.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨基线对特定登革病毒血清型的免疫力如何影响Dengvaxia®疫苗的表现,填补了关于疫苗在血清阳性个体中效力的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在菲律宾于2016年建立的前瞻性队列研究,旨在根据基线登革病毒血清状态评估Dengvaxia®的表现,重点关注对DENV1、DENV2、DENV3或DENV4具有免疫力的儿童。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过分析中和抗体(Ab)反应和疫苗复制动力学,评估了对每种登革病毒血清型具有基线免疫力的儿童中疫苗的反应。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究发现,对DENV4具有基线免疫力的儿童中,疫苗被抑制的频率很高(61%),而对其他血清型具有免疫力的儿童则表现出二次交叉中和抗体反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果直接指出先前的DENV4免疫力与疫苗被抑制之间的关联,并确认了Dengvaxia®中DENV4成分的复制优势。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对评估其他登革病毒疫苗在血清阳性个体中的表现具有更广泛的意义,特别是强调了需要考虑血清型特异性疫苗接种的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其仅限于单一地理区域和特定疫苗,但证据强度较高,因为直接观察到了对DENV4具有免疫力的儿童中疫苗被抑制的现象。

papers.title: When the forest speaks again: in-depth genomic analysis of serotyping failure reveals geographic extension of sylvatic DENV-2 in southeastern Senegal, 2026
papers.abstract: Abstract In August 2026, eight febrile patients in the Kédougou and Tambacounda regions of Senegal tested positive by pan-flavivirus and pan-dengue RT-PCR but could not be assigned to a serotype. In-depth genome sequencing identified sylvatic dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2, genotype VI). These findings indicate the re-emergence and geographic spread of DENV-2/GVI beyond its historical focus.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨发热患者血清型鉴定失败的原因,并确定森林型登革病毒2型是否正在扩展其在塞内加尔东南部的地理范围。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究于2026年8月在塞内加尔的凯杜古和坦巴库南达地区进行,涉及八名发热患者,他们通过登革病毒检测呈阳性,但无法被归类为特定血清型。
elements_zh.methods: 使用广谱黄病毒和广谱登革热RT-PCR检测病毒RNA,并进行深入基因组测序以确定病毒的特定血清型和基因型。
elements_zh.main_results: 基因组测序结果显示,该病毒为森林型登革病毒血清型2(DENV-2,基因型VI)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,DENV-2/GVI正在重新出现,并在该地区的地理范围上扩展,超出其以往已知的地理边界。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究强调了改进监测和诊断方法的必要性,以检测和监测森林型登革病毒2型的地理扩展,这可能影响公共卫生策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅基于摘要层面的证据,且结果基于小样本量,这可能影响研究发现的普遍适用性。证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Feasibility and Acceptability of a Dengue Board Game for Primary Health Care Nurses
papers.abstract: Background: Primary health care (PHC) nurses are central to dengue prevention and management, but lecture-based training might not effectively engage learners. Game-based learning offers an interactive alternative that promotes participation and skill reinforcement. Purpose: To evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of a dengue educational board game for PHC nurses. Methods: A single-arm pre-post feasibility study was conducted in two PHC units in Indonesia. The board game, developed from national dengue guidelines and validated by experts, integrated knowledge-based, case-based, and skill demonstration tasks. Feasibility was assessed through recruitment, attendance, and completion rates. Acceptability was measured with a five-item Likert scale and qualitative feedback. Exploratory outcomes of knowledge, attitudes, and confidence were descriptively summarized. Results: Feasibility criteria were met, with full participation and completion. Acceptability ratings were high, as all participants strongly agreed the game was enjoyable, relevant, and useful for knowledge and skills. Descriptive analyses suggested positive trends in post-intervention median scores for knowledge (from 4.0 to 6.0), attitudes (from 27.0 to 29.5), and confidence (from 18.5 to 21.5). Satisfaction was also high (median 25.0, interquartile range 24.3–25.0). Conclusions: The dengue board game was feasible and acceptable, supporting further evaluation in a controlled trial for scalable workforce training.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the feasibility and acceptability of a dengue educational board game for primary health care nurses in Indonesia. The game was developed from national guidelines and validated by experts, incorporating knowledge-based, case-based, and skill demonstration tasks. The study found that the game was fully participated in and highly acceptable, with positive trends in knowledge, attitudes, and confidence scores. The results suggest that the game could be a useful tool for training PHC nurses in dengue prevention and management. However, the study's single-arm design limits the strength of the evidence, and further controlled trials are needed to assess its effectiveness for scalable workforce training.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 初级卫生保健(PHC)护士在登革热预防和管理中起着核心作用,但以讲座为主的培训可能无法有效吸引学习者。基于游戏的学习提供了一种互动替代方案,能够促进参与和技能强化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在印度尼西亚的两个初级卫生保健单位进行了一项单臂前后可行性研究。该研究聚焦于初级卫生保健护士,并评估了登革热教育棋盘游戏的可行性与可接受性。
elements_zh.methods: 该游戏基于国家登革热指南并由专家验证,整合了基于知识、基于病例和技能演示任务。通过招募、出勤率和完成率评估可行性。通过五点李克特量表和定性反馈测量可接受性。
elements_zh.main_results: 可行性标准已达成,所有参与者均完全参与并完成游戏。可接受性评分很高,所有参与者都强烈同意该游戏令人愉快、相关且有助于知识和技能的提升。描述性分析显示,干预后知识(从4.0到6.0)、态度(从27.0到29.5)和信心(从18.5到21.5)的中位数得分呈现积极趋势。满意度也很高(中位数25.0,四分位距24.3–25.0)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 登革热棋盘游戏具有可行性和可接受性,支持在受控试验中进一步评估,以实现可扩展的卫生人员培训。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于游戏的学习可能是培训初级卫生保健护士进行登革热预防和管理的有价值的工具,可能有助于提高参与度和知识保留率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项单臂可行性研究,这限制了因果结论的得出。证据强度中等,因为其基于描述性总结和自我报告测量。

papers.title: Secondary Analysis of Clinical Bulk RNA-Sequencing Samples from Dengue Virus-Infected Patients Reveals EGFR, mTOR, and VEGF-A as Potential Therapeutic Targets
papers.abstract: Almost half of the human population lives in areas where dengue virus (DENV) is endemic and are at risk of infection. The aim of the current study was to analyze 65 publicly available bulk RNA-sequencing samples from the GEO NCBI database. We hypothesized that investigating gene expression in patients with DENV infection compared to healthy controls could identify potential therapeutic targets and augment our understanding of the intracellular transcriptomic response to DENV infection. We report various genes with significant differential expression and multiple predicted drug targets that could be repurposed to reduce the signs and symptoms associated with DENV infection.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了GEO NCBI数据库中65个公开的bulk RNA测序样本。这些样本来自DENV感染患者与健康对照组。

elements_zh.main_results: 我们报告了多种具有显著差异表达的基因以及多个可被重新利用的预测药物靶点,以减轻与DENV感染相关的症状和体征。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为这些发现可以提供关于DENV感染细胞内转录组反应的见解,并提出潜在的治疗靶点。这是一种通过转录组分析识别药物靶点的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来关于登革病毒感染治疗干预的研究提供信息,并有助于开发针对性的治疗。它们还可能增强我们对DENV感染分子机制的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于公开数据的二次分析,这可能引入数据偏差或数据质量限制。由于依赖现有数据集而非原始数据收集,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence in early diagnosis of mosquito-borne viral infections: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: Early diagnosis of mosquito-borne viral infections is challenging because initial symptoms are often nonspecific and confirmatory testing may be delayed or unavailable. We synthesised evidence on artificial intelligence and machine learning models for the early diagnosis of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. We conducted a PRISMA 2020-compliant systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD420251129670). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus were searched from inception to 11 August 2025 for model-development or validation studies reporting diagnostic performance. Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), accuracy, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) were pooled using random-effects models, while sensitivity and specificity were jointly synthesised using a bivariate random-effects model. Risk of bias was assessed using the Prediction model Risk Of Bias Assessment Tool (PROBAST). Database searches identified 4,531 records, of which 43 studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence was predominantly from Asia and overwhelmingly focused on dengue; no eligible studies evaluated West Nile virus, yellow fever, or Rift Valley fever. Pooled estimates were 0.954 (95% CI 0.936–0.968) for AUC, 0.904 (95% CI 0.888–0.918) for accuracy, 0.903 (95% CI 0.876–0.925) for PPV, and 0.882 (95% CI 0.859–0.902) for NPV. The bivariate pooled sensitivity was 0.861 (95% CI 0.809–0.900) and specificity was 0.902 (95% CI 0.871–0.927). Heterogeneity was substantial for the univariate outcomes (I 2 95.8%–97.7%). Most studies were at high overall risk of bias, while calibration and external validation were uncommon. Artificial intelligence models showed encouraging diagnostic performance in the published literature, but the pooled estimates should be interpreted as descriptive summaries of a highly heterogeneous evidence base rather than as definitive estimates of real-world performance. Prospective, externally validated, well-calibrated, and geographically diverse studies are needed before routine clinical implementation can be recommended.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluates the diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning models for the early diagnosis of mosquito-borne viral infections, specifically focusing on dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The review identified 43 studies from PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus, with a pooled AUC of 0.954 (95% CI 0.936–0.968), accuracy of 0.904 (95% CI 0.888–0.918), PPV of 0.903 (95% CI 0.876–0.925), and NPV of 0.882 (95% CI 0.859–0.902). Sensitivity and specificity were pooled at 0.861 (95% CI 0.809–0.900) and 0.902 (95% CI 0.871–0.927), respectively. However, the evidence base is highly heterogeneous, with substantial I2 values for univariate outcomes. Most studies were at high risk of bias, and external validation was rare. The review highlights the need for more robust, geographically diverse, and well-calibrated studies before AI models can be recommended for routine clinical use.

papers.title: Obesity in Children is Associated With Increased Dengue Virus Binding, but not Neutralizing, Antibody Responses Following Primary Infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Obesity has been associated with higher risk of dengue virus (DENV) infection and disease, yet its influence on antibody responses to DENV remains undefined. Methods We evaluated whether nutritional status—based on body mass index z-score (BMIz)—or blood markers of body fat—leptin and adiponectin—are associated with binding and/or neutralizing antibody responses to DENV in 85 children in the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study who experienced a primary DENV infection in 2019. Associations were estimated using linear models adjusting for age, sex, and DENV infection outcome. Results Compared with children with normal weight, those with obesity had higher quantities of DENV binding antibodies (fold-change [FC] 1.89, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.02, 3.48) but no difference in neutralizing antibodies. Likewise, leptin concentration was associated with higher quantities of binding antibodies (FC 1.22, 95% CI 1.09, 1.37), while adiponectin was associated with lower quantities (FC 0.79, 95% CI .67, .94), and neither was associated with neutralizing antibodies. Lower neutralizing efficiency (neutralizing/binding antibodies) was observed in children with obesity (FC 0.67, 95% CI .48, .93). Conclusions Our results indicate that obesity is associated with higher antibody quantity (binding) but not higher quality (neutralization) postprimary DENV infection—implying that antibodies generated by children with obesity have lower neutralization efficiency, requiring greater quantities to reach similar levels of neutralization than children with normal weight. Further, the agreement among the 3 models using distinct proxies of body fat—BMIz, leptin, and adiponectin—demonstrates that adipokines are useful in supplementing BMIz analysis or as independent predictors of immune responses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the association between obesity and antibody responses to dengue virus in children, addressing the gap in understanding how nutritional status influences immune responses to dengue infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated 85 children from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study who experienced a primary dengue virus infection in 2019, assessing the impact of body mass index z-score, leptin, and adiponectin on binding and neutralizing antibody responses.
analysis.methods: Associations were estimated using linear models adjusting for age, sex, and dengue infection outcome, with binding and neutralizing antibody responses measured using specific assays.
analysis.main_results: Children with obesity had higher quantities of binding antibodies but no difference in neutralizing antibodies compared to those with normal weight. Leptin was associated with higher binding antibodies, while adiponectin was associated with lower binding antibodies, with no effect on neutralizing antibodies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that obesity is associated with higher antibody quantity (binding) but not higher quality (neutralization) post-primary dengue infection, implying lower neutralization efficiency in children with obesity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results indicate that adipokines, such as leptin and adiponectin, are useful in supplementing BMIz analysis or as independent predictors of immune responses, highlighting the importance of considering body fat markers in understanding immune responses to dengue virus.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include the observational nature and the potential for confounding factors, which may affect the strength of the evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the impact of obesity on antibody responses to dengue virus in children, finding that obesity was associated with higher binding antibodies but not neutralizing antibodies, suggesting lower neutralization efficiency in obese children.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨儿童肥胖与登革病毒(DENV)抗体反应之间的关联,填补了对营养状况如何影响登革病毒(DENV)感染的抗体反应理解的空白。
